---
title: "long-weights-demo"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(ipeval)

set.seed(123)

treatment_of_interest <- c(0,1,0,1,0)

pattern1 <- c(0,1,0,0,0)
pattern2 <- c(0,1,0,1,1)
pattern3 <- c(0,1,0,1,0)
pattern4 <- c(0,1,1,1,1)

data_long <- data.frame(id = c(rep(1,5), rep(2,5), rep(3,5), rep(4,5)),
                        visit_time = rep(c(0,1,2,3,4), 4),
                        A = c(pattern1, pattern2, pattern3, pattern4),
                        L = rnorm(20))

data_long$visit_compliant <- treatment_of_interest[data_long$visit_time+1] == data_long$A
data_long$has_deviated <- unlist(tapply(data_long$visit_compliant, data_long$id, function(x) { cumsum(!x) >= 1}))



data_wide <- reshape(data_long, direction = "wide", idvar = "id", timevar = "visit_time")
data_wide <- data_wide[, c("id", paste0("A.", 0:4), paste0("L.", 0:4))]

data_long$factor_visit_time <- factor(data_long$visit_time)

print(data_wide)
print(data_long)
```

# Long weights, old approach
Fit model A ~ L*visit on all rows of data_long:

```{r}
weights_model <- glm(A ~ L * factor_visit_time, data = data_long, family = "binomial")
```

Compute probability of being assigned the treatment that they were assigned per visit:

```{r}
prob_A_is_1 <- predict.glm(weights_model, type= "response", newdata = data_long)
prob_A_is_a <- ifelse(data_long$A == 1, prob_A_is_1, 1 - prob_A_is_1)
visit_weight <- 1 / prob_A_is_a
```

Compute IPTW of each patient by taking the product, and set weight to 0/NA for those not compliant to entire treatment strategy:

```{r}
weights_approach1 <- tapply(visit_weight*data_long$visit_compliant, data_long$id, FUN = prod)
weights_approach1
```

# Long weights, new approach 1
Fit model A ~ L * visit on treatment-compliant rows of data_long, including the first non-compliant row p patient:

```{r}
in_model_building_dataset <- data_long$has_deviated
data_long <- add_lag_terms(data_long, "has_deviated", lag = 1, fill = F)
data_long$in_model_building_dataset <- !(data_long$has_deviated_lag_1)

weights_model2 <- glm(A ~ L * factor_visit_time, data = data_long[data_long$in_model_building_dataset, ], family = "binomial")
```

Compute probability of being assigned the treatment that they were assigned per visit:

```{r}
prob_A_is_1 <- predict.glm(weights_model2, type= "response", newdata = data_long)
prob_A_is_a <- ifelse(data_long$A == 1, prob_A_is_1, 1 - prob_A_is_1)
visit_weight <- 1 / prob_A_is_a
```

Compute IPTW of each patient by taking the product, and set weight to 0/NA for those not compliant to entire treatment strategy:

```{r}
weights_approach2 <- tapply(visit_weight*data_long$visit_compliant, data_long$id, FUN = prod)
weights_approach2
```

# Long weights, new approach 2
Fit model artificially_censored ~ L * visit_time on treatment-compliant rows of data_long, including the first non-compliant row p patient:

```{r}
data_long$artificially_censored <- !(data_long$visit_compliant)
weights_model3 <- glm(artificially_censored ~ L * factor_visit_time, data = data_long[data_long$in_model_building_dataset, ], family = "binomial")

prob_censor_is_1 <- predict.glm(weights_model3, type= "response", newdata = data_long)
prob_censor_is_c <- ifelse(data_long$artificially_censored == 1, prob_censor_is_1, 1 - prob_censor_is_1)
visit_weight <- 1  / prob_censor_is_c
```

```{r}
weights_approach3 <- tapply(visit_weight*data_long$visit_compliant, data_long$id, FUN = prod)
weights_approach3
```

In this case the weights between the new approaches are equivalent. Not always the case.



```{r}
print(data_long[, c("id", "visit_time", "A", "visit_compliant", "has_deviated",
                    "in_model_building_dataset", "artificially_censored")])
```


# Sanity check

```{r}
# required to run ip_score_long, values dont matter for the IPTW
data_outcome <- data.frame(id = c(1,2,3,4), time = c(5,5,5,5), status= c(T,T,T,T))

ip_score_long(runif(4), data_outcome, data_long,A ~ L * factor(visit_time), treatment_of_interest = c(0,1,0,1,0), metrics = NULL, visit_times = c(0,1,2,3,4), time_horizon = 5)$ipt$weights

```
